name: EHE-08 — Structural Concrete Code
description: Validates structural concrete specifications against the Instruccion de Hormigon Estructural (EHE-08). Checks exposure class (I, IIa/b, IIIa/b/c, IV, Qa/b/c), minimum concrete strength for durability, cover requirements, reinforcement steel type (B 400 S / B 500 S / B 500 SD), execution control level (normal / intenso / estadistico), and that the plan de control de calidad (quality control plan) is referenced.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
regulator: Ministerio de Transportes y Movilidad Sostenible
